bingo.rules.title: Bingo Game Rules
bingo.rules.goal: Your goal is to collect specific items as quickly as possible and fill your Bingo card. The game is played in teams, and the first team to complete its objective wins.
bingo.rules.modes.line_desc: "%s": Complete one row on the Bingo card. This can be horizontal, vertical, or diagonal (5 items).
bingo.rules.modes.cross_desc: "%s": Complete two intersecting rows of items, forming a cross. This could be horizontal and vertical lines or intersecting diagonals (9 items).
bingo.rules.modes.full_house_desc: "%s": Collect all items on the card to win.
bingo.rules.difficulty.standard_desc: "%s": Recommended for most players. All items are easily accessible and found only in the Overworld, making for a comfortable game.
bingo.rules.difficulty.difficult_desc: "%s": Increased difficulty. You'll need to collect items from both the Overworld and the Nether, making it more challenging.
bingo.rules.difficulty.hard_desc: "%s": The hardest mode. You'll have to gather rare and hard-to-reach items from the Overworld, Nether, and End.
bingo.rules.start_desc: After entering the command %s, the game will begin, and each player can choose a team. You can join any team; there's no player limit per team. You can play solo, team up with friends, or create multiple teams – it’s up to you. Discuss the setup with others before starting. The rules are flexible, and you can customise the game however you like as long as everyone agrees.
bingo.rules.commands.quit: Use this command to leave the game. It will remove you from the current Bingo game.
bingo.rules.commands.interface: This command allows you to adjust the timer display and item list position. It's recommended for a better gameplay experience.
bingo.rules.commands.show_rules: This command shows the game rules. Use it for a quick overview of the objectives and gameplay before starting.
bingo.rules.commands.start: Use this command to start the game. Once entered, the game will begin immediately and you can start working toward the goal.
bingo.rules.version_desc: Different Bingo versions are designed for specific versions of Vanilla Minecraft Java Edition. Make sure you're using the correct game version for compatibility.
